description:
Welcome to Craftaria — a blocky sandbox world with no limits! Mine, craft, build, and survive across an endless procedurally generated landscape. Whether you love creative building or the thrill of survival, Craftaria puts an entire world in your hands. 🌍

⛏️ INFINITE WORLDS

Explore a world that never ends. Terrain generates around you as you travel — no walls, no boundaries, just endless adventure. Every world is unique, shaped by its own seed.

🌲 EXPLORE DIFFERENT BIOMES

Journey across lush green plains, snowy taiga forests with towering spruce trees, and warm acacia lands with golden-orange grass. Each biome has its own look and feel to discover.

🏗️ BUILD ANYTHING

Place and break hundreds of block types to build whatever you can imagine — from a cozy house to a massive castle. Creative mode gives you every block and the power to fly. Your imagination is the only limit.

🗡️ SURVIVE THE WORLD

In survival mode, gather resources, craft tools and weapons, manage your health and hunger, and defend yourself against creatures that roam the world. Mine deep underground to find ores and treasures hidden in the dark.

🐄 ANIMALS & FARMING

Raise animals, harvest crops, and build your own farm. Plant wheat, carrots, and potatoes, and turn your harvest into food to keep you going.

🔥 TORCHES & DAY-NIGHT CYCLE

Watch the sun rise and set over your world. Light up the night with torches and keep building around the clock.

👑 FACE THE BOSS

Think you've mastered the world? Discover a hidden arena and battle a mighty boss in an epic showdown. Only true legends will prevail.

🌐 PLAY WITH FRIENDS (OPTIONAL MULTIPLAYER)

Team up with friends in private multiplayer! Host a world and share your PIN code — only players you invite can join. Build together, explore together, and take on the world as a team.

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE CRAFTARIA

• Infinite, procedurally generated worlds

• Creative AND survival modes

• Three unique biomes to explore

• Hundreds of blocks to build with

• Crafting, mining, farming & combat

• Animals, crops, and resources

• Private invite-only multiplayer

• Smooth performance, even on older devices

Download Craftaria now and start building your world, block by block! 🧱

Whether you're here to create, explore, survive, or play with friends, your adventure starts now.

Think you know all the animals around you? Then embark on an adventure to capture as many animals as possible and complete your collection to become the best Zoofoxer!

Professor Foxy, a leading animal expert, has realized that his animal data seems to be completely inaccurate. Could someone have altered it? description:
Imagine a world where your heroes continue to battle, level up, and collect loot even when you're not playing. That's the magic of idle quest RPGs, a mobile game genre that has taken the world by storm.

Idle Hunter: Eternal Soul are a subgenre of role-playing games (RPGs) that focus on character progression and resource management, with minimal player input required. This means you can set your characters to fight and collect resources even while you're away from the game, making them perfect for busy people or those who enjoy a more relaxed gaming experience.

FEATURE:

- Automatic combat: Your characters will fight and defeat enemies automatically, even when you're not playing.

- Collect resources, such as gold, experience points, and equipment, to upgrade your characters and progress through the game.

- Gacha mechanics: idle quest allow you to randomly acquire new characters and equipment.

- Progression systems: Idle Quest RPGs typically have a variety of progression systems, such as character levels, equipment upgrades, and skills, that you can use to make your characters stronger.

Why Play Idle Hunter: Eternal Soul?

- Perfect for busy people: You can play them in short bursts or leave them idle in the background.

- Relaxing and addictive: The simple gameplay and steady progression make them a great way to unwind.

If you're looking for a mobile game that you can play in short bursts or leave idle in the background, an idle quest might be the perfect choice for you. With their simple gameplay and addictive progression systems, idle RPGs are a great way to pass the time and relax.

description:
Nub wants the flag. The floor has other ideas.

Nubfall is a platformer that lies to you. The gap you cleared last time is one tile wider. The ceiling comes down where you learned it doesn't. The flag has moved, and it will move back before you can prove it.

Then you die, and the game makes a noise about it — a little higher each time you die in the same spot, until it is openly laughing at you.

• 100 hand-made levels across ten worlds, each with its own rule and its own colour

• Death is free. No ads on death, no dialog, no confirmation — under a fifth of a second from dying to playing again

• Every trap warns you before it fires. Once. After it has killed you, it stays visible forever

• Controls you can actually change: left or right handed, button size, button opacity, and a one-button mode that plays the entire game

• Works on a plane. No account, no network, no ads, no timers, no lives

• Every level has been proven beatable by a search over the real game simulation. Unfair is a design choice here. Impossible is a bug

Nub has died a great many times. Nub is fine. Nub is not fine.

Can you escape Onsen is a free 3D escape room game set in a snowy hot spring town at the foot of a mountain. Gather the clues, find hidden items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play with confidence.

Warm flickering lights, sparkling white snow.

A series of riddles unfold in a hot spring resort nestled at the foot of a mountain.

Will you be able to collect clues and escape from this place?

Enjoy a relaxing time in the quietness of winter. Explore the hot spring town, search for the clues hidden there, and find your way out.

■ An escape room game anyone can clear

The difficulty is set for beginners to intermediate players. Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers are provided, so even if you've never played an escape room game before, you can play casually and clear it all the way to the end. Look closely, think it through, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.

If you love mystery games, puzzle adventure games, or hidden object games, you'll feel right at home. Tap every place that catches your eye, collect items and hints, and use them to get the keys and open the way out.

■ Observation and a flash of inspiration

Tap any place you're curious about—you may find an item or a hint. Make full use of everything you find to get the keys. In this point-and-click escape game, sharp observation and a sudden flash of inspiration are what lead you out. Piece the clues together like a detective, one by one.

■ Keep the clues you want to see again

Found a clue you'll need later? You can save it and look back at it whenever you like, so you don't have to remember every detail or go back and search again. It's a small help that makes solving the mysteries of the hot spring town more comfortable.

■ Hints and answers when you need them

Stuck on a puzzle? Check Hint 1 first, and if you still need help, Hint 2. The answer is there too, so you never have to give up halfway. Use as much help as you like and enjoy the mystery at your own pace.

■ A quiet winter in a hot spring town

Warm lights flicker against the white snow, and the mountain stands quietly behind the town. Between puzzles, take a breath and enjoy the stillness of winter. This escape game is made for a slow, relaxing moment.

■ Play anytime

Your progress is saved automatically, so you can play a little during a short break and pick up where you left off later. Or settle in on the weekend and aim to escape all at once.

This title includes Stage 1 only. Please look forward to our next title.

■ Features

・Difficulty for beginners to intermediate players

・Hint 1, Hint 2, and answers

・Save clues to review later

・Autosave

・Free to play

■ How to Play

・Tap the place you are interested in

・You will get items and hints

・Make full use of them to get the key

・Observation and a flash of inspiration are important

■ Recommended for

・Beginners trying an escape room game for the first time

・Fans of room escape games, mystery games, and brain games

・Players who enjoy point-and-click adventures and finding hidden items

・Anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle game to play in short breaks

・Lovers of snowy scenery, winter, and hot spring towns

■ More escape games from ArtDigic

ArtDigic creates 3D escape games set in beautiful villas, seaside houses, and resorts around the world. If you enjoy Onsen, look for our other escape room games and continue your journey from one mystery to the next.

Can you escape from the snowy hot spring town?

Enjoy a relaxing time in the quietness of winter.

description:
Ranatics Mobile is an online role-playing game about students, rivalries, and the fights that settle them. Pick a school, pick a class, and go find out who runs the campus.

CHOOSE HOW YOU FIGHT

Four classes, each with its own feel and its own skill tree:

- Brawler - close the distance and stay there

- Swordsman - reach, pressure, and heavy openings

- Archer - control the fight from where it cannot reach you

- Shaman - keep your side standing, and take the other side apart

A WORLD THAT DOES NOT WAIT

Three schools share one world, and the ground between them is contested. Other players are really there: in the same field, at the same boss, after the same drop. Chat happens over people's heads. Fights start because someone walked into the wrong place.

BUILT FOR A PHONE, NOT PORTED TO ONE

The controls were made for thumbs. A stick you can hold anywhere, skills on an arc where your hand already is, and a HUD you can move and resize until it fits the way you play - then save it, and it follows your account to your next device.

PLAY WITH PEOPLE

- Guilds, with ranks and a guild hall to sink your money into

- Parties for the fights you cannot take alone

- Duels when the argument needs settling now

- Trading, face to face, with both hands on the table

THINGS TO DO BESIDES FIGHTING

Quests that actually send you somewhere. A shared storage vault. Item mixing and upgrading for when the gear you have is nearly the gear you want. A world map and bus stops so getting there is not the game.

OPEN BETA

The game is in open beta and it shows: we are adding, fixing and occasionally breaking things in public. Progress may be reset while we test. If something is wrong, tell us - the notice board on the login screen is where we answer.

Free to play. An account is required, and you can delete it from inside the game at any time: Options > Account.

description:
Survivor.io suits players who want short sessions with strong replay value during commutes or quick breaks. You enter a city under siege, face relentless enemies, and grow stronger within a single run as your choices stack up. As the pressure rises, positioning and timing matter more, so quick reactions help you stay alive. For users looking to play on Android, the Survivor.io APK offers a straightforward way to get started.


Survivor.io features

Simple one hand controls

Survivor.io uses a control layout that keeps play comfortable on a phone. You guide your character with one thumb and focus on movement to avoid contact. The interface keeps attention on the action, so you can clear maps in short bursts. This approach makes it easy to pick up and continue a run whenever you have a few minutes.

Roguelite skill building during runs

Level ups happen mid run, and each level offers skill choices. You select upgrades, stack effects, and build combinations that shape how your character fights for the rest of that run. The next attempt starts fresh, which encourages new builds and different paths. Over time, learning which skills work well together helps you push farther.

Huge enemy counts and crowd control

Survivor.io can send over one thousand monsters onto the screen, so crowd control becomes essential. You manage space by finding safe gaps and steering away from pressure while your chosen skills handle groups. As enemy waves intensify, you balance survival and risk to collect more experience. Decisions made under pressure often determine whether you clear the stage or repeat it.

Stage variety and rising challenge

Stages bring different layouts, enemy types, and pacing. Early sections teach basic movement, while later sections raise difficulty with denser waves and tougher patterns. Randomized upgrade choices add variety from run to run, which supports replay value. As you get comfortable with one map, moving to a higher difficulty keeps the game engaging.

Offline single player on Android

Survivor.io works without a connection, so you can play anywhere. Runs start and end offline, and content is based on your in game progress. This setup suits users who want a reliable single player experience on the go. It also makes short sessions possible when you have limited reception.


Events and cosmetics in Survivor.io

Seasonal events add extra goals and rewards to regular play. For example, a Spring Carnival event may include themed challenges and cosmetics, such as Drone skins. These rewards change the look of certain equipment and keep the game fresh without altering core controls. Event availability and details appear in the in game notifications and event tabs.


Run structure and pacing

Each run in Survivor.io starts from a base state and grows through your level up choices. The game emphasizes learning enemy patterns, spacing, and building reliable skill sets. Since runs reset, you can try new combinations immediately after finishing or failing. This loop makes experimenting feel natural and encourages gradual improvement.


How to play Survivor.io on Android

Use these steps to begin and complete a run with basic controls and clear goals. To explore the Survivor.io latest version features on Android, follow a simple flow and adjust choices as you progress.

  1. Open Survivor.io and select a stage from the main screen, then confirm your entry to start the run.
  2. Move with one thumb and keep distance from incoming enemies, adjusting your path as pressure builds.
  3. Collect experience from defeated monsters, then choose a skill whenever the level up prompt appears.
  4. Build combinations over time by selecting skills that work together, and reposition when waves get dense.
  5. Continue until the stage is cleared, review your results, then start another run or pick a harder stage.


Start playing Survivor.io

Survivor.io focuses on short runs, flexible skill builds, and offline single player on Android. Users can download Survivor.io to try new builds and test different stage strategies at their own pace.

INTERACTIVE FICTION WITHOUT THE RAILS

description:
Every detective game has the same rhythm: gather the evidence, ask the right questions, name the killer. Open Verdict keeps the rhythm and rebuilds the interrogation.

There's no multiple choice. You sit across from the suspect, ask whatever you want in your own words, and they answer in character. They lie. They contradict each other. They slip, and a sharp detective catches it.

HOW A CASE WORKS • Read the briefing as the case opens on its scene • Examine the evidence where it was found • Question every suspect: ask anything, or pick from the prepared lines • Catch the lie, then press them with the evidence • Name the killer and attach your proof. Three pieces that agree make an AIRTIGHT case; a guess is just a guess

EVERY SUSPECT COULD BE THE KILLER Solved a case? Play it again. On most cases the killer can be someone else next time, with their own motive, their own lies and their own trail of evidence.

FIVE ERAS OF MURDER Victorian London, 1920s Prohibition, the gritty 1970s, the present day and a neon near future, each with its own Bureau captain, forensics expert and coroner.

HEAR THEM Recorded voices for every briefing, every piece of evidence and every verdict. Play a voiced case and every suspect answers you out loud. Your first voiced case is free.

MAKE IT YOURS • Choose your detective: portraits across every heritage, young to seasoned • Choose your interrogation style. Suspects react to how you work a room, never with more than they know • Choose your difficulty: Guided, Standard or Hard-boiled • Rise through the ranks from Rookie to Chief Inspector, earn commendations and a nickname, and fill your gallery with every killer you've caught

SEASONAL CASE FILES New cases arrive with the seasons, and they're yours to keep. Gothic Case Files 2026 is here for Halloween.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE English, Spanish and Portuguese (Brazil): every screen, every case, and the suspects' answers. The recorded voices speak all three.

FREE TO PLAY • Cases you can play with prepared lines, no questions required • 50 free questions to ask anything, on any case • An ad between cases. Any purchase removes ads for good

WHEN YOU WANT MORE • Question packs: buy once, they never expire • Bureau Premium: questions every month, plus every new case No energy timers. No loot boxes. Nothing expires. Stop for a month and pick up where you left off.

ABOUT THE AI • Suspect dialogue is written in the moment by Anthropic's Claude, from authored case files, with safety rules • Recorded voices are made with ElevenLabs from authored scripts • Artwork is made with fal.ai Flux from authored prompts • Full details on first launch, in the app, and at openverdict.app/privacy

In Mega Man Advanced PET you become a NetBattler, navigating a sprawling digital landscape that fuses fast‑paced run‑and‑gun action with deep RPG‑style chip collection, upgrade trees, and a living online hub that feels like plugging into a retro PDA. Every step you take charges your Cyber‑Meter, letting you launch devastating Virus Patrols, while the Bluetooth‑enabled Net Station (BT) lets you meet nearby opponents for real‑time battles and chip trades—all without leaving the comfort of your smartphone. The game stays true to its offline‑first roots: your progress, chips, and settings are saved locally by default, giving you a reliable, privacy‑respecting experience that works even when you’re off the grid. When you choose to go online, an optional Supabase backend syncs your save, fuels global leaderboards, and opens The Square—a walk‑able live arena where you can chat, challenge rivals, and showcase your custom loadout. Choose from a massive library of Battle Chips, combine them by matching code or name, and unleash powerful combos that feel as satisfying as slotting a cartridge into a vintage Game Boy Advance. The upgrade system rewards careful planning: each level‑up grants five skill points that you distribute across Strength, Defense, Vitality, Rapid, Charge, and Luck, shaping a build that matches your playstyle. Whether you prefer a high‑damage Buster rush, a swift Rapid‑fire barrage, or a resilient tank that soaks up enemy fire, the choice is yours. The game also features a robust account system: register with your email, set a unique in‑game name, and enjoy cross‑device cloud backup so your NetBattler is always ready for the next encounter. Should you ever wish to start fresh, a single tap wipes both local and cloud data, giving you a clean slate without leaving any trace behind. Visually, Mega Man Advanced PET pays homage to the 8‑bit era with a crisp, dark‑blue UI, glowing neon accents, and pixel‑perfect sprites that animate smoothly on modern displays, while the chiptune‑inspired soundtrack keeps the adrenaline pumping. Regular events, seasonal chip drops, and community‑driven tournaments keep the world fresh, ensuring that every session feels like a new mission in an ever‑expanding network. description:
Can you escape Port Town is a free 3D escape room game set in a colorful port town with a South American atmosphere. Gather the clues, find hidden items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play with confidence.

Amidst the cascading summer sun, a town adorned in shimmer,

A port town watched by lofty towers, mysteries that glimmer.

Can you gather the clues, escape this enigmatic domain,

In this vibrant harbor, tranquility you shall attain.

Enjoy a leisurely time in a port town overflowing with color. Explore the streets under the summer sun, search for the clues hidden around the harbor, and find your way out.

■ An escape room game anyone can clear

The difficulty is set for beginners to intermediate players. Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers are provided, so even if you've never played an escape room game before, you can play casually and clear it all the way to the end. Look closely, think it through, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.

If you love mystery games, puzzle adventure games, or hidden object games, you'll feel right at home. Tap every place that catches your eye, collect items and hints, and use them to get the keys and open the way out.

■ Observation and a flash of inspiration

Tap any place you're curious about—you may find an item or a hint. Make full use of everything you find to get the keys. In this point-and-click escape game, sharp observation and a sudden flash of inspiration are what lead you out. Piece the clues together like a detective, one by one.

■ Memos for clues

Found a clue you'll need later? Keep a memo of it and look back whenever you like, so you don't have to remember every detail or go back and search again. It's a small help that makes solving the mysteries of the port town more comfortable.

■ Hints and answers when you need them

Stuck on a puzzle? Check Hint 1 first, and if you still need help, Hint 2. The answer is there too, so you never have to give up halfway. Use as much help as you like and enjoy the mystery at your own pace.

■ A sunny day in a vibrant harbor

Summer sunlight pours down on shimmering streets, and tall towers watch over the town. Between puzzles, take a breath and enjoy the bright, colorful air of the harbor. This escape game is made for a slow, relaxing moment.

■ Play anytime

Your progress is saved automatically, so you can play a little during a short break and pick up where you left off later. Or settle in on the weekend and aim to escape all at once.

■ Features

・Difficulty for beginners to intermediate players

・Hint 1, Hint 2, and answers

・Memos for clues

・Autosave

・Free to play

■ How to Play

・Tap the place you are interested in

・You will get items and hints

・Make full use of them to get the key

・Observation and a flash of inspiration are important

■ Recommended for

・Beginners trying an escape room game for the first time

・Fans of room escape games, mystery games, and brain games

・Players who enjoy point-and-click adventures and finding hidden items

・Anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle game to play in short breaks

・Lovers of summer, harbors, and colorful towns

■ More escape games from ArtDigic

ArtDigic creates 3D escape games set in beautiful villas, seaside houses, and resorts around the world. If you enjoy Port Town, look for our other escape room games and continue your journey from one mystery to the next.

Can you escape from the colorful port town?

Enjoy your leisurely time in the vibrant harbor.

Shipwrecked. Stranded. Alone on a lost desert island in the middle of the ocean. Last Pirate: Survival Island is an offline open world island survival game and survival simulator: gather resources, craft weapons, farm, hunt and fish, build a raft, a boat and a pirate ship, fight zombies, monsters and bosses like the Kraken, and become a pirate legend.

🏝 CASTAWAY SURVIVAL SIMULATOR

You wake up on a tiny island with nothing. Scrape the rust and oxide off your sword: survival on this island starts now, so fight for your life in the dying light. Around you is a sea of thieves, zombies and monsters. Find food and water, chop wood, break stones and survive every night in the wilderness. Can you survive 7 days on this lost island? Every day is a new survival challenge, and the further you go, the more dangerous it becomes.

🏴‍☠️ GAME FEATURES

• Survival craft: collect wood, stone, fruit and loot, then craft tools, clothes, axes, swords, guns and armor. Crafting is the key to survival.

• Farm, hunt and fish: grow your own farm, hunt animals, find fruit and clean water. Build a raft and go fishing on the ocean for food.

• Build a ship: take quests, gather materials and build your pirate ship step by step, then sail the deep sea in your own boat.

• Open world survival game: explore the huge open world island, find treasure maps, uncover the secrets of the forest and its local tribes, and hunt for hidden treasure in a sea of thieves and monsters. Treasure hunt is part of every adventure.

• Fight monsters and bosses: zombies, wild animals and giant sea monsters attack day and night, because the ocean is home to the Kraken. Upgrade your weapons and learn how each enemy fights.

• Day and night cycle: gather by day, fight and survive at night. Danger loves the dark.

• Play offline: no internet needed for this pirate survival adventure.

🛠 HOW TO PLAY

Use one hand to move your pirate and the other to chop trees, mine stone, fight monsters and interact. Your backpack is limited, so spend resources wisely. Use daylight to gather food and materials, build your ship and upgrade your weapons.

🎮 WHY PLAYERS LIKE LAST PIRATE

• An offline survival game you can play anywhere, no wifi needed

• Craft, farm, build and explore in one open world island game

• Pirate adventure with a treasure hunt and a ship to sail

• Simple two-thumb controls

• Updates with new content

description:
SCRAM is hide and seek for the real world. Split into hunters and runners, start the clock, and play across your street, park, campus or campsite, with your phone keeping score.

HOW IT WORKS

• Runners get a head start to hide.

• Every few minutes the hunters get a ping: each runner's location pops up on their map, marked with how long ago it was.

• Each team sees its own players live. Between pings the hunters are guessing, and runners never see hunters at all.

• Stray outside the play zone and, after 30 seconds, the hunters can see you live until you're back in.

• Tag someone in person and they tap "I got tagged". Last runners standing when time runs out win.

YOU SET THE RULES

The host picks the round length, the head start, how often the pings come (or none at all), and the play zone: its size, where it sits, and how often it shrinks. Or switch the zone off and play anywhere. Everyone joins with a six-character game code.

MADE FOR PLAYING OUTSIDE

• Alerts reach you with your phone locked: pings, the head start ending, the zone shrinking, and tags.

• Radio keeps each team talking without the other team listening.

• Alerts buzz instead of ring, so they won't give away where you're hiding.

YOUR LOCATION, ONLY WHEN IT COUNTS

SCRAM shares your location only during a round, and only with the players in your game. Games are private and need their code to join, and they're deleted after seven days.

FREE TO JOIN

Downloading SCRAM and joining games is free. Hosting your own games is a one-time purchase: no subscription and no ads.

Play somewhere safe, keep an eye on traffic, and stay off private property.

No rescue is coming. How long will you survive?

Project Deadzone is a hardcore isometric zombie survival game, built from the ground up for phones. It is 1993. Pinecrest, a quiet American town, has fallen to an unknown infection, and the army has sealed off the whole county. You are still inside.

There is no hand-holding and no second life. Every can of food, every bandage and every sound you make matters. This is not a game about winning. It is a game about how you die, and how long you hold out before you do.

★ DEEP SURVIVAL, ONE LIFE

Hunger, thirst, fatigue, stamina and panic. Scratches, lacerations, bleeding and bites. A bite carries the infection, and a fever can kill you. Death is permanent: when you fall, your save is gone.

★ SEARCH EVERY HOUSE

Kick open doors and search over 300 containers across an open town: kitchens, bedrooms, garages, a supermarket, a pharmacy, a hardware store, a gas station and a police station. Food spoils, weight slows you down, and your backpack is never big enough.

★ FIGHT, OR DON'T

Baseball bats, crowbars, fire axes, machetes, knives, pistols, shotguns and rifles. Shove, kick and stomp on the fallen. Throw molotovs and grenades. Every swing costs stamina, and every gunshot calls the horde. Sometimes the smartest move is to sneak, switch off your flashlight and wait.

★ ZOMBIES THAT HUNT

They see, they hear and they remember. They follow noise, break down doors, climb through windows and roam the streets in packs. At night they come out in greater numbers, and the dark is truly dark.

★ DAY, NIGHT AND WEATHER

A full day and night cycle, rain, storms and fog. Power and water fail as the days pass. Barricade windows and doors with planks and nails, and pick a safe house before night falls.

★ A STORY WITH FIVE ENDINGS

A child's voice crackles over the police radio. A doctor left letters behind. The military is hiding something. You have five days until the evacuation, and your choices decide how it ends.

★ YOUR SURVIVOR

Choose from 7 occupations and 13 traits, customize your look, level up 6 skills and read skill books to learn faster.

★ MADE FOR MOBILE

Touch controls designed for phones, a hand-drawn town map with markers, auto-save, and sessions that fit a bus ride or a whole evening.

Warrior: Help protect your cave and fight alongside you.

Explorer: Send them on adventures in the martial world to gather resources for you.

Alchemist: Help increase the success rate of potion brewing.

One-time payment: No pay-to-win system or ads interrupting cultivation.

Chinese brushstroke style artwork: Exquisitely designed UI and effects create a beautiful atmosphere of the immortal world.

Cloud Save system: Connect your Google account to continue playing anytime, anywhere.

The AI does not choose the killer while you play. Every culprit, timeline, clue and solution is authored in advance. The AI gives each suspect a voice; the case engine protects what really happened.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Interrogate suspects in natural language

- Search the board for evidence and hidden leads

- Rebuild the timeline of the crime

- Track stress, trust, lies and contradictions

- Accuse with culprit, method, motive and proof

STORIES TO SOLVE

From locked rooms and country houses to theatres, trains, factories and poisonings, every case has its own cast and logic chain. Clues matter: miss one and the picture stays incomplete; connect them and one answer remains.

FOUR WAYS EVERY CASE CAN END

Naming the killer is not the end of it. Every case has four different endings, and which one you get depends on what you proved, who trusted you, and what you left buried. Close the same file twice and it can finish differently. Your casebook keeps a record of which endings you have unsealed.

SOLO OR CO-OP

Play alone, or invite another detective into the same investigation. You share suspects, evidence, notes and timeline without waiting for each other. Only the inviting detective needs Premium; the invited partner joins that shared case free.

FREE TO START, FAIR TO FINISH

Cases open through play, not through a paywall. Premium gives you unlimited hints and opens every case right away, but the case stories themselves stay playable for everyone.

description:
CoinTex is a fast-paced arcade adventure across 60 hand-tuned levels and 6 themed worlds which are Meadow, Desert, Ocean, Cavern, Volcano, and Space. Every screen has the same simple mission where you need to grab every coin before the clock runs out. The hard part is staying alive long enough to do it.

Each world introduces one new twist on the same rules, shown with a quick heads-up the first time it appears:

• Meadow & Desert — learn the layout. Time your runs around wandering monsters and patrolling fires.

• Ocean — fires now pulse. Their hitbox grows and shrinks, so move on the small breaths.

• Cavern — the nearest monster locks on and chases you. You also unlock a rechargeable laser that auto-aims at your closest threat — fire, then watch the orange reload dial tick down.

• Volcano & Space — stronger hits, tighter timers, and a brutal final stretch.

Features

• 60 levels across 6 themed worlds with a steady, monotonic difficulty curve.

• An auto-aim rechargeable laser from world 4 onward, plus freeze-clock pickups that stop monsters and fires in their tracks for a few precious seconds.

• Multi-hit monsters with visible health pips, and health drops to keep you in the fight.

• Two-player local multiplayer over Wi-Fi (host or join by IP). Play co-op and share the coin count, or go head-to-head in versus mode — most coins wins.

• An interactive tutorial and a guide screen that explains every sprite, hazard, and rule in plain language.

• A built-in AI auto-player you can dial between cautious / balanced / aggressive and slow / normal / fast — let CoinTex play itself, or use it to scout a level that's giving you trouble.

• Per-world music and hand-synthesized sound effects.

• Lightweight, runs offline. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

Controls are touch-only: tap where you want to go and your character runs there, weaving past hazards on the way. From world 4, a tap on the gun button fires at the nearest monster.

Discover the colorful world of adventures in the game "Bobatu Island". The uninhabited island hides many stories and secrets, but only to those who are not afraid to go on this journey, wise ancestors will reveal the secret of an ancient civilization.

Key features of the game "Bobatu Island":

EXCITING PLOT:

Together with the main characters of the game, you have to cross the ocean and uncover the secret of a lost civilization. Touch the world of adventure, solve the secrets of ancient temples and stone idols and go through all the puzzles and trials to save your friend!

JOURNEY:

You are with us along the way! Amazing adventures await you at the very edge of the earth: wild beaches, rocky shores, dormant volcanoes, marshy swamps, impenetrable forests and mangrove jungles. And if you try to enter a dark cave, you will surely find a mountain of gems and meet the one who lives there.

STUDY:

Explore the surroundings of the island properly! Among the thickets you can see abandoned temples, majestic ruins and mysterious mechanisms. Rumor has it that they keep the secrets of a lost civilization.

FUN FISHING:

You will need a fishing rod and bait to try your luck at fishing. And the most nimble and experienced natives will be able to cook their catch in the Tropical Kitchen.

TROPICAL FARM:

Gather juicy fruits and fruits from exotic trees, plant and grow crops, and have your own animals. Set up your farming business and be ready for new adventures!

AMAZING FINDINGS:

Mysterious artifacts and mythical treasures promise fame, wealth and good luck! Find out if the stories and legends that these lands keep are true!

TROPICAL TRADE:

The doors of the merchant's shop are open for travelers! Collect coins, make purchases, sell and exchange the collected resources, and decorate and develop your base on the island with the proceeds.

BUILDING AND CRAFTING:

Build buildings and upgrade buildings to unlock new types of crafting and create even more unique resources. Build bridges and ferries to explore the most remote places of the island. To travel to the ends of the earth, build a raft, but if you want, you can make a real ship out of it.

GAME FEATURES:

You will find funny 2d animation, funny characters, dozens of bright locations, daily events, intuitive controls and many unique game mechanics. The game "Bobatu Island" can be played offline, but in order to save game progress and send and receive gifts to friends, you need to connect to the game server.

Surviving on the island is not an easy task, these tips will come in handy:

- Gather resources, craft tools and weapons to explore the island and develop your base.

- Meet the inhabitants of tropical islands, new acquaintances and friends will be useful to you!

- To get a big harvest, buy additional plots of land in the tropical shop.

- Farm and look for seeds of new plants to develop your garden and vegetable garden.

- Tropical cuisine is your key not to feel hungry. Build this building and learn how to cook food, drinks and other dishes.

- Don't forget to take care of the animals so that your pets bring valuable resources.

- If you install fences, your animals will be safe and predators will not be able to get to them.

- Be careful! Wild and very hungry animals can hide in the jungle!

- Be more decisive! Closed doors and stone walls are no reason to retreat! To overcome the obstacles formed, look for keys, create master keys or try to find a workaround.

- Be attentive! Bushes, palm trees, and flowers can hide something important from view!

Trust the spirits of the island! Beware of traps and use clues to solve the riddles of abandoned temples and find your missing friend.

description:
TURN YOUR CITY INTO A GIANT GAME

HideZone brings Hide & Seek and other real-life multiplayer games outside. Use live GPS to play with your friends across parks, neighborhoods, forests, downtown streets, and anywhere else you want to play.

Create a private game, invite your friends, and choose your game mode. Hide, hunt, chase, survive, and see who can outsmart everyone else.

GAME MODES

● Hide & Seek: The classic game with a shrinking zone. Stay hidden and keep moving while Seekers track you down.

● Zombie Infection: One player starts as Patient Zero. Every tag creates a new zombie until survivors grab the antidote in the Cure Zone.

● Chase / Manhunt: High-speed real-life chase. Seekers only get a vague search circle instead of an exact location, making every pursuit unpredictable.

● Assassin: Everyone gets one secret target. Eliminate your mark to inherit theirs until only one player remains.

● Freeze Tag: Get tagged and freeze in place with your location revealed. Teammates must reach you to thaw you back into the game.

● Mr. X Hunt: Mr. X sees all Detectives live on the map, while Detectives only receive periodic location pings. Coordinate and corner Mr. X before time runs out.

● Sardines: Reverse Hide & Seek. One player hides and everyone searches. When you find them, hide with them until one searcher is left.

● Murder Mystery: One player is secretly the Murderer. Complete GPS tasks for clues and eliminate suspects, but pick wrong and you both lose.

● Meteor Escape: Meteors strike across the map. Stay on the move, avoid the blast zones, and be the last player standing.

ITEMS THAT CHANGE THE GAME

● Scanner: Reveal enemy locations for a short time.

● Decoy: Place a fake GPS ping on the map and send your opponents in the wrong direction.

● Proximity Mine: Place a digital trap and get alerted when someone walks into it.

● Ghost Mode: Temporarily disappear from GPS and set up an ambush.

● Zone Mover: Move the game zone and force players out of their hiding spots.

● And more: Discover new ways to trick, track, and outplay your opponents.

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

● Live GPS: Real-time location tracking designed for outdoor multiplayer games.

● Private Lobbies: Create your own game and invite 2 to 100+ players with a Lobby ID.

● Crossplay: Play together regardless of which phone everyone uses.

● No Account Required: Start playing without signing up.

● Privacy First: Your location data is deleted when the match ends.

● No Pay-to-Win: Winning comes down to skill, strategy, stamina, and teamwork.

From classic Hide & Seek to GPS manhunts, zombie infections, Assassin matches, and more, HideZone gives you a whole collection of real-life games to play with friends.

Grab your friends, head outside, and let the hunt begin.

description:
Your AI Dungeon Master in your pocket. Infinite AI-driven RPG adventures with

real dice, real combat, and companions who remember every promise you made.

Free credits every day.

QuestSmith is the AI roleplaying game where your imagination writes the story.

Build a hero, roll a D20, fight a dragon, travel with a companion who can turn

on you, or just type what you want to do — the AI responds and the world

adapts. No menus. No scripts. No two adventures the same.

✦ TWO WAYS TO PLAY

• Story Mode — tap Start and jump straight into the action. Perfect for

open-ended narrative, romance, mystery, slice-of-life, and horror.

• Campaign Mode — full RPG. Create a character, roll stats, fight with HP/MP,

follow a structured quest path, and level up the hero you built.

✦ REAL D&D MECHANICS

• D20 action checks with Difficulty Class and stat modifiers

• Four core stats: Combat, Magic, Stealth, Social

• Live HP and MP tracking

• Multi-enemy combat encounters

• Quest log that updates as you play

• Win-chance preview before every roll

✦ AI COMPANIONS WITH A MIND OF THEIR OWN

Pick a travel companion and they'll behave like a real party member, not a

chatbot. They have personality, mood, and a trust meter that rises and falls

based on your choices. They can disagree with you, refuse your orders,

pursue their own side quests, and even betray you. Open a private 1-on-1

chat with them at any time during the adventure.

✦ A STORY THAT REMEMBERS YOU

Persistent long-term memory means the AI remembers your choices, promises,

enemies, and allies across the entire campaign — not just the last few turns.

Undo, redo, and checkpoint any moment if you want to try a different path.

✦ AI ART FOR EVERY SCENE

Generate gorgeous illustrations of your characters and locations in multiple

styles — fantasy, anime, comic book, cozy storybook, manga, cinematic, and

photoreal. Save them to your gallery to keep.

✦ ANIMATED VFX & SOUND

Sword clashes, magic sparkles, lightning, fire bursts, portal openings, level-

ups, ambient rain and fog — over a dozen built-in animations and sound effects

fire automatically during dramatic moments. The visual mood shifts with the

tone of the scene.

✦ BUILD AND PUBLISH YOUR OWN ADVENTURES

QuestSmith ships with a full scenario creator. Write the world, design

characters, script Acts → Arcs → Beats, set the rules, and publish your

adventure for the community to play. AI auto-fill can draft a full scenario

from a one-line idea (premium).

✦ CHARACTER VAULT

Build a hero once, reuse them forever. Save full character sheets — race,

class, stats, appearance, backstory — and bring them into any new adventure.

✦ COMMUNITY OF STORYTELLERS

Browse trending and new scenarios, bookmark favorites, follow creators,

discuss your favorite campaigns in threads, and report inappropriate content.

✦ DAILY STREAKS & FREE CREDITS

Check in daily for streak rewards and free credits. Optional credit packs

and three premium tiers (Champion, Legend, Mythic) unlock larger memory,

creator tools, and faster sessions if you want them.

✦ AVAILABLE IN 5 LANGUAGES

English, Spanish, French, German, and Italian — switch any time.

✦ MADE FOR

• Solo D&D players who don't have a group tonight

• Tabletop fans who want a DM in their pocket

• AI Dungeon and Tales RPG fans looking for deeper companions and memory

• Writers who want an AI co-author

• Anyone who loves choose-your-own-adventure stories

Download QuestSmith and meet your AI Dungeon Master. Roll your first D20 in

under a minute — your story is waiting.

Crafting and Building suits players who want a calm space to create at their own pace. You can shape towns, decorate interiors, and walk through pixel worlds with simple controls that feel familiar on mobile. Offline play supports quiet sessions on the go, while online sessions let you visit friends and build together. Many players looking for relaxed building choose to download Crafting and Building for straightforward, family friendly play without pressure.


Crafting and Building features

Calm creative sandbox

Crafting and Building removes monsters and combat so you can focus on building and exploring. Create houses, castles, gardens, and entire streets, then wander through caves to find places for new projects. The pace stays relaxed, which helps new players and families enjoy the game without stress.

Online co building with friends

You can visit friends and work together on large builds. Join a shared world, divide tasks, and see progress grow faster as everyone contributes. For smoother sessions, a stable internet connection is recommended when you play together online.

Many blocks and furniture options

Crafting and Building provides a wide range of materials, from grass and diamond to temple stone. Use furniture to design interiors and exteriors so each room and outdoor space looks distinct. This variety helps you match materials to the style you want for each project.

Pets and villagers add activity

Dogs, horses, and villagers move through your towns to make them feel lived in. You can interact with them and place builds around their routines to create a lively center, a farm area, or a quiet neighborhood. These characters help your world feel active without adding combat.

The Operator suits players who prefer solving cases through documents, databases, and careful observation rather than direct action. You work as a new desk operator for the fictional FDI, helping field agents handle crimes while following a larger mystery. Each case asks you to compare details, check records, and decide what information matters. If you want to download The Operator, expect a story focused on deduction and connecting leads.


The Operator features

Handle cases from an FDI console

The Operator places you at a computer workstation instead of sending you into the field. You receive requests from agents and review the information available to them. Your role is to find useful details and pass them on while an operation is in progress.

Investigate different types of crimes

You can work on cases involving murders, missing people, and cyberattacks. Each investigation presents a different set of facts and possible leads. As cases develop, you need to consider how one event or person may relate to another.

Review digital evidence

The Operator lets you inspect case files, documents, photographs, and videos for clues. Small details can help confirm identities, locations, or connections between suspects. Therefore, reading carefully and comparing evidence is important before sending findings to field agents.

Use fictional FDI databases and tools

You can search the Citizen Database and Vehicle Database when a case provides names, faces, or registration details. Other tools include the Video and Photo Analyzer, ChemScan, Notepad, and Terminal. These systems give you different ways to check evidence, although you must decide which information applies to the current case.

Follow the HAL investigation

Individual cases form part of a wider story involving HAL, a cybercriminal. The Operator uses branching leads, so findings from one situation can change how you understand later events. Taking notes can help you keep track of names, facts, and unresolved questions across the investigation.


The Operator trial and full game

A free trial is available, allowing players to try the desk-based investigation format before deciding whether to purchase the full experience. The trial can help you determine whether the game’s focus on reading, searching records, and logical reasoning matches your preferred style. The full game continues the wider case narrative and its connected investigations.


Before choosing The Operator APK

The Operator APK is designed around a computer-style interface on an Android device. Much of the gameplay involves reading files, examining images, entering searches, and comparing information instead of fast reactions. Players who enjoy crime investigation stories and evidence analysis may find this format more suitable than games centered on direct chases or combat.


How to investigate in The Operator

After installing the game, begin as a new FDI desk operator and follow the case information shown on screen. The Operator latest version presents investigations through the same core workflow of receiving requests, checking evidence, and reporting findings. Pay attention to details that appear across several files.

  1. Open the current case and read the request from the field agent, noting any names, locations, vehicles, or unusual facts.

  2. Check the available documents, photos, and videos, then look for details that may identify a person or explain an event.

  3. Search the FDI tools, such as the Citizen Database or Vehicle Database, using the information you have found.

  4. Compare search results with the evidence and use the Notepad when you need to track connections or unanswered questions.

  5. Send the relevant finding to the agent and continue following new leads as the case develops.


Start an FDI case

The Operator is a desk-based crime investigation game built around supporting field agents and linking evidence. Try the free trial first, then continue with the full investigation if its case-solving format suits you.

description:
apparish turns your city into a haunted map. Spirits are everywhere once you look. Some drift through the streets. Some linger at the places they're bound to: the old churches, the cemeteries, the hotels. And at sites with a real haunted reputation, the legendary ones are waiting.

No sign-up required. Open the app and the ghosts on your street are already there.

A ghost hunting game played on real streets

The map is your neighborhood. Ghosts show up near you and gather at real haunted places, and the rare ones keep to the spots with the strongest stories. Walk up, raise your camera, and capture them.

Every ghost is one of a kind

No two spirits are the same. Each one has a name, an era, a backstory and a mood, and the one you catch on your corner is not the one your friend catches on theirs.

Ask them anything

Talk to your ghosts in real time and they'll talk back. They remember you. They have opinions. Ask how they died, what they want, or what they think of your street.

No two captures play alike

Capturing a spirit means winning one of 14 minigames, from sealing a ward to herding wisps to playing a haunted song note by note. A legendary ghost won't be caught until you win its minigame.

A haunted house to call home

Your Sanctuary is where your ghosts live. Open new rooms, decorate them, and give each spirit a place to settle in.

A daily tarot draw

Once a day, shuffle the deck and pick one of three cards. The card you turn over pays out Ectoplasm, experience or a sealed chest, and gives you a reason to go back out tonight.

Keep them close or lose them

A ghost you ignore is a ghost you lose. Neglect one too long and it slips away, off to haunt someone who actually shows up. Other hunters walk the same streets, and your spirit could become theirs.

Out-hunt the neighbors

Every week you're placed in a league with hunters at your rank. Everything that earns you experience that week counts toward the standings, and placing well pays out.

Ghost tours you can walk

Take one of 39 walking ghost tours, from Boston's old burying grounds to Mexico City's Centro Histórico. Your own ghost walks with you and tells the legend at every stop. Tours stay on public streets and plazas, and you can leave whenever you like.

For anyone who likes the paranormal

If you read ghost stories, watch paranormal shows or just like a good haunted walk, apparish gives you a reason to go outside and see what's been there the whole time.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://appari.sh/terms-of-service

description:
In The Lost Signal: SCP you can become one of the agency’s staff members investigating paranormal phenomena. Currently, a Class D staff member and a Field Agent are available.

Class D knows and sees very little; all he gets are orders, and all he does is directly interact with dangerous phenomena. Learn the basics of the game and feel the atmosphere by playing as him.

The Agent knows much more. He was sent to an agency station from which contact was lost, and there he is free to investigate as he sees fit. His task is to find out what happened. Upon arriving, he discovers that the agency has long since lost control over the anomalous phenomena. What more he can learn about the situation depends entirely on the player's actions. What you uncover and study will influence your character’s fate and the agency’s overall results. Each ending uncovered by the player will reveal a part of what's really happening.

The Lost Signal: SCP is a world‑exploration game. To understand what’s happening around you, you’ll have to dive into the strangest worlds and dimensions, uncover many well-hidden secrets, and inspect a wide variety of anomalous objects. The main tool is your radio, through which you can report discovered phenomena and earn Observation Points, the universal currency in a world where information is the ultimate value.

Every location you can reach has its own unique character. Some realms will frighten you:

Endless claustrophobic corridors, the “wardrobe labyrinth,” a ruined world overrun by bloodthirsty zombies, and other dangerous dimensions evoke classic horror games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill.

A pistol, a knife, and other weapons help you survive these perilous worlds. Weapons keep monsters at a distance.

The Desert, Forest, and Gas Mask worlds lean more toward titles like Yume Nikki and LSD: Dream Emulator, evoking liminal spaces or dreams.

Water and canned food help restore health and stave off hunger during long explorations of these places. Hunger and thirst can be more dangerous foes than monsters. In the desert, you’ll need to drink a lot, so thorough preparation is essential.

A flashlight is indispensable where it’s dark.

As an Agent, you choose which of these worlds to prioritize for your investigations.

The anomalous objects you encounter reference various stories from the SCP site:

SCP-1499 by Trasknari, SCP-1497 by TwistedGears, SCP-860 by Enma Ai, SCP-1767 by Roget, SCP-249 by Dr Gerald, SCP-847 by WrongJohnSilver, SCP-970 by Freudian, SCP-426 by Flah, SCP-432 by evilscary, SCP-895 by Aelanna, SCP-084 by Dr Gears, SCP-087 by Zaeyde, and others.

Outrun your opponents, perfect your jumps, and prove you’re the fastest in the obby escape tournament.

Your performance at each checkpoint matters — the thrill of competition keeps every second intense and rewarding.

💀 Boss Arenas & Survival Tension

Prepare for the toughest trials — boss arenas that combine rhythm, timing, and survival.

Face a laser-eyed doll that tracks every move, dodge mechanical crushers, avoid swinging blades, and stay alive while the floor collapses beneath you.

Every boss fight feels like a unique obby escape puzzle where patience and quick reflexes mean survival.

Explore the real world

Start a GPS session, walk or run through your neighborhood, and watch your route contribute to your progress. Visit new tiles, uncover new places, gather resources, and bring what you find back to your garden.

Track distance, time, pace, and visited tiles, then review your adventure afterward with route recaps and session history. Bring companions along to help with tile visits, resources, watering, soil, weeds, and other garden tasks.

Discover new biomes

Explore different biomes where different plants can grow. Find new areas, improve your fields there, and create the right places to grow new and exotic plants.

As you explore more of the real world, you can discover new possibilities for your garden and expand the variety of crops you are able to grow.

Grow your garden

Build your home garden from the ground up. Clear weeds, till soil, plant seeds, water crops, harvest produce, and improve your tools as you play.

Every seed and harvest can have its own quality, giving you reasons to keep growing, experimenting, and collecting better crops. Discover fruits, vegetables, herbs, mushrooms, flowers, rare plants, and unusual seed variants as your garden expands.

Grow beyond simple farming with useful structures and science machines. Build and upgrade structures that affect nearby tiles, such as watering surrounding plants, improving adjacent soil, or granting extra actions.

Cook with your harvest

Turn the produce you grow into dishes. Unlock recipes, experiment with ingredients, fill kitchen jobs, and use cooked dishes for requests, festivals, progression, and collection goals.

Explore beneath the surface

Unlock cave entrances through requests and explore procedurally generated underground worlds filled with cave flora and resources. Discover what lies underground and use your cave actions and tools as you explore.

Meet companions

Meet companions and build relationships through requests and adventures. Companions can join your journey, gain affection, support your active sessions, and provide useful effects while you explore.

Complete mystery objectives to earn experience, resources, tools, decorations, cooking stations, cave actions, hints, and more.

Collect and discover

Gnomia is full of discoveries. Use the catalog to track seeds, produce, dishes, and growth stages. Unlock hints that point toward recipes, secrets, and hidden progression paths without giving everything away at once.

Chase achievements, improve your best seeds, collect rare items, upgrade tools, earn daily rewards, visit markets, and keep uncovering new systems as your garden grows.

Make it your own

Customize your gnome with different hats, hair, body options, and other details. Decorate your garden with unlockable decorations and create a space of your own.

Play together

Create or join a community and take part in weekly festivals. Contribute to shared festival boards, complete festival requests, claim rewards, and help your community level up over time.

Work together by contributing seeds, produce, resources, and dishes, add friends, and compare your progress through leaderboards and rankings.

Whether you want a relaxing garden to check each day, a reason to go for a walk or run, a collection game with deep progression, or a community challenge to share with friends, Gnomia gives every step a purpose.

Plant, walk, run, cook, explore, decorate, and discover the hidden life growing all around you.

Did you enjoy Death Attraction?🎈 In the quiet town of Darcy, Maine, children have begun to vanish without a trace. The police are baffled — no clues or evidence that could help in the search for the missing schoolchildren. Among the local kids, rumors circulate about a clown resembling IT, who looks like a snowman, named Boris. They say he freezes children into ice and takes them to his home, which has been turned into a death children's park with terrifying rides, and then butchers them into pieces to make ice cream. Afterward, this clown-snowman eats them to keep himself from melting. They say that during the day, his old van, resembling an ice cream truck, stands in the children's park, where the clown, covered in ice cream, sells delicious popcorn. On dark evenings, this clown drives around town looking for children — but these are just guesses. One of the missing schoolboys also claimed that he saw the clown loading a large bottle with green liquid, resembling mint syrup for ice cream, into his van. A week after this story, the schoolboy disappeared. The children claim that the clown-snowman Boris is involved.

In Frosty Smile, you will play as a schoolboy named David and escape from the maniac's house. He and his friends got too close to solving the mystery of the maniac clown-snowman.

Waking up in a dark basement, among the frozen shadows of former victims, where the chilling screams of children can still be heard, David realizes: his only chance is to escape and tell the truth. The police won't believe a child's words, so irrefutable evidence is needed. The goal of the game is to explore Boris's terrifying house and collect evidence: from the laboratory with bubbling syrup to the freezer room and the terrible secrets of the past of the clown-snowman maniac named Boris.

Take part in a scream-chilling investigation, making your way through the corners of a madman's house. Under no circumstances should you scream. You need to be quiet as a mouse and cunning as a fox to hide from Boris, who wanders through the corridors, checking his "supplies."

Features:

Blood-Freezing Atmosphere of New England: Immerse yourself in the autumn landscapes of the town of Darcy, Maine, and its most terrifying house, which looks like a death horror park.

Unique Clown: Come face to face with the maniac — a frightening hybrid of a clown and a snowman.

Detective Story: Collect newspaper pages, children's drawings, and entries in the clown-snowman's diary to uncover his dark secret.

From the creator of Death Attraction

Key features of Kin: The Beyond

Game based introductions

Kin: The Beyond lets you meet potential matches through live interactive games. Playing together gives both participants something to discuss while getting acquainted. This approach can suit users who find opening messages difficult or prefer a more social first interaction.

Live Connect Trivia sessions

You can join Live Connect Trivia and invite available participants to take part in a real time session. The shared questions create a starting point for interaction before a more personal conversation begins. Kin: The Beyond uses these sessions as one way for people to spend time together in the app.

Profile recommendations and interest options

Invitations and shared game lobbies

When an invitation is accepted, Kin: The Beyond opens a shared lobby for both participants. You can then choose a game to play together. This keeps the connection process focused on a joint activity before deciding whether to continue.

Mutual chat and account controls

You can continue talking through in app messaging when interest is mutual. Kin: The Beyond also lets you review Crushes you received and receive notifications about activity. Reporting, blocking, moderation tools, and optional verification indicators are available to help users manage their interactions.


What to consider before using Kin: The Beyond

Kin: The Beyond is a game first dating and social discovery app from Nyxion LLC. Its matching flow depends on browsing profiles, showing interest, and joining an activity with another person, so it may be more suitable for users who want interaction before messaging. Chatting continues when both people show interest, rather than after a one sided profile action.

Live activities depend on other available participants and accepted invitations. Therefore, the experience can vary depending on who is online and willing to join a trivia session or game lobby at that time.


How to use Kin: The Beyond

The Kin: The Beyond latest version follows a social discovery flow that begins with profiles and moves into shared games. Create a profile first, then use the available discovery options to find people you may want to meet. Continue only when the interaction feels appropriate to you.

  1. Create your social profile so other users can view your information during discovery.

FOR PLAYERS WHO LIKE

Crime stories told through screens, cold case podcasts, mystery games and puzzle games built

on deduction rather than reflexes, and long evenings spent proving somebody wrong.

Six complete cases, 115 stages: Nora’s Disappearance has 15, and the other five have 20 each. Nora’s Disappearance, Dead Air, The Last Pin and The Paper Daughter are free. PhonePlot+ unlocks the two premium cases, Glass House and Low Tide.

Available in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish,

Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Arabic.

for this game.

description:
School Party Craft suits players who enjoy social worlds with flexible creative play and quick activities. You move through a large city, meet others, and make everyday choices like where to hang out or what to build at home. The tone stays casual, yet there is plenty to discover as you roam from one area to the next. For users who install apps directly, School Party Craft APK can be used to set up the game on Android.


School Party Craft features

Social city life and chat

School Party Craft centers on a social open-world where you meet friends and talk through in-game chat and SMS. You can gather at restaurants, parks, beaches, and nightclubs, then switch between first or third person camera to suit the moment. Dynamic weather and time of day change the mood around town, so a sunny afternoon at the beach feels different from a late night at the disco.

Build and decorate your home

You can claim a large plot, demolish old walls, and rebuild your mansion from the ground up. The building set includes blocks, doors, chandeliers, plants, and hundreds of furniture items, letting you set a clear style for every room. Chairs, beds, and other pieces are interactive, so you can sit and sleep as you arrange spaces and refine the layout. This part of play connects naturally with social visits, since friends can drop by and see what you made.

Vehicles and travel options

Movement around the city is varied and flexible. You can drive and tune cars, ride motorcycles, bikes, scooters, and skateboards, or take ship cruises and airplane flights to change the pace. These travel choices help you reach new areas quickly, which keeps daily routines simple when a plan involves several stops. The feeling of getting from one place to another stays straightforward thanks to intuitive controls.

Activities and city hotspots

Across the map you will find places that offer small tasks and downtime activities. You can shop at the market for furniture, blocks, skins, and paintball gear, then order music from DJs at the disco to set a playlist for the group. The cinema, school, bank, car dealership, gas station, and pools add familiar settings that guide casual meetups and mini missions. Moving between these spots helps structure sessions without forcing a strict schedule.

Paintball battles and mini-games

When you want action, paintball arenas offer quick matches with clear goals. The weapon set includes miniguns, pistols, assault rifles, and playful extras like Dinogun and Bazooka-Shark, so you can pick something that suits the match style. Paintball also ties into the wider economy, and you can reclaim coins from hooligans during rounds. This mode gives short bursts of arcade challenge that fit between building, shopping, and social time.


Useful notes about School Party Craft

Online interaction is a core part of the game. A stable internet connection helps with chat, shared spaces, and meeting other players in busy areas. Usernames and messages are visible to others in public zones, so choose a name you are comfortable sharing.

School Party Craft may display ads during play. If you prefer to keep current, check this page for the School Party Craft latest version and update when a new build becomes available.


How to play School Party Craft on Android

To begin, download School Party Craft and open the game on your device. The first minutes focus on basic setup and simple movement so you can ease into city life.

  1. Start the game, then follow the on-screen prompts to enter a nickname and pick an initial look.
  2. Next, learn movement with the on-screen joystick and adjust the camera between first and third person.
  3. Then, walk to nearby hotspots and talk with others using in-game chat or SMS.
  4. After that, visit the market to get building blocks or outfits, and check a few venues like the cinema or disco.
  5. Finally, claim a plot to build your mansion, place furniture, and join a paintball match when you want a quick challenge.


Start exploring the city

School Party Craft blends social hangouts, creative building, travel, and quick action in one shared world. To try the full set of features, install the School Party Craft latest version and enter the city when you are ready.

Infinite Lives suits players who like open combat and character-driven choices. You enter a 3D city where superpowered groups clash and survival depends on timing and positioning. You create an origin and decide how far to push new abilities. Allegiances and control shift often, so each run can feel different. If you prefer flexible action with room to retry, download Infinite Lives and play on your schedule.


Infinite Lives Features

3D combat rooted in wrestling

Infinite Lives uses a third person system built around strikes, grapples, and positional control. Movement across height and space affects each encounter, so spacing, throws, and holds can decide a fight and keep battles varied.

Tell an origin and grow powers

You build a backstory and make choices that shape abilities and standing in the city. Progress can push you beyond human limits, while careless decisions may cost traits that ground your character. The loop supports trying different approaches over time.

Territory fights and shifting allegiances

You face hundreds of heroes and villains competing for control across a wide map. Groups can switch sides and priorities quickly, just as easily as changing your look. Dozens of locations include interactive weapons and destructible objects that influence tactics.

A subscription removes ads and lets you save edits to any character you defeat. The Fight Scenes mode allows custom matchups by selecting who fights, where they meet, and what they use. When returning to the city, you can start each new life fine tuned to your liking with more options unlocked over time.


Get started with Infinite Lives

Dragon Traveler fits players who want a role playing game that can move forward even during short breaks. It uses an isekai comedy setting with quick story scenes, character collection, and reward systems built around regular check ins. As a result, the game may suit users who prefer light daily play instead of long grinding sessions. If you plan to download Dragon Traveler, the main experience centers on collecting Luminaries, gaining resources over time, and following short character driven episodes.


Main Dragon Traveler Features

Idle Progression With AFK Rewards

Dragon Traveler lets you collect loot, diamonds, and upgrade materials while you are away from the game. This idle structure helps players keep progress moving without repeating long battles for every small reward. When you return, you can claim the saved resources and use them to strengthen your team. This makes the game easier to fit into a daily phone routine.

SSR and SSR Plus Luminary Collection

You collect anime style Luminaries through the gacha system, with SSR and SSR Plus characters as the main focus. Dragon Traveler highlights characters such as Poseidon, Vermilion Bird, Xuanwu, White Tiger, Ifrit, and Vivienne during different summon periods. In addition, the game promotes guaranteed pull messaging, including the chance to obtain a desired character within 50 pulls or less. Players who enjoy collection based RPGs should pay attention to banner timing and character availability.

Short Comedy Story Chapters

Dragon Traveler presents its story in short chapters that usually fit into a few minutes. The setup uses isekai comedy, princess and dragon banter, and quick episode pacing, so you can read through scenes without a long time commitment. Each chapter is designed to move the story forward in small parts. Because of this, the game works well for users who want story content in short sessions.

Romance and Bond Interactions

You can build bonds with characters and take part in romance focused interactions. Dragon Traveler includes confession moments and exclusive story scenes tied to character relationships. These systems give collection more context because characters are not only used for battle or upgrades. However, players should know that some reported gender choices may not strongly change every story cutscene.

Limited Events and Reward Tasks

Dragon Traveler adds time based events that can include themed skins, animated avatars, login gifts, sports themed activities, summons, and reward tasks. These events are important for players who want extra character items or limited rewards. Since some Luminaries may have limited upgrade paths, event returns and shard access can matter when planning collection goals. Checking event pages regularly helps you avoid missing summon periods or claimable rewards.


What to Know Before Playing Dragon Traveler

Dragon Traveler gives several free rewards through login bonuses, AFK diamond income, weekly SSR claims, and launch style reward campaigns. These rewards can help new players build an early team without needing to grind for long periods. At the same time, character collection still depends on summon systems and event schedules. Players who care about a specific Luminary should review the active banner before spending resources.

The game also places clear attention on limited characters and themed content. Ifrit, Vivienne, and other promoted Luminaries may not always be available in the same way after their banner ends. Some players may also want more shard sources, especially through systems such as Love Trials. For that reason, it is useful to treat limited summons and upgrade materials as long term decisions rather than quick one time choices.


How to Play Dragon Traveler on Android

Dragon Traveler is simple to start because most early progress comes from story stages, summons, and claimed rewards. After installing the Dragon Traveler APK, you can follow the opening tasks and use the first rewards to build a starting team.

  1. Open Dragon Traveler and follow the first story prompts until the game introduces battles, rewards, and character menus.
  2. Claim available login gifts, launch rewards, AFK income, and any beginner rewards before using upgrade materials.
  3. Use summons to collect Luminaries, then check character roles and rarity before deciding which units to strengthen first.
  4. Return to the main story and clear short chapters to open more systems, rewards, and character interactions.
  5. Check limited events and daily tasks after each session so you can collect extra items while your AFK rewards continue building.


Start With Dragon Traveler

Dragon Traveler is an idle gacha RPG for players who want AFK rewards, SSR and SSR Plus collection, short comedy chapters, and character bond scenes in one mobile game. Download the Dragon Traveler latest version to follow the current story content, summons, and available event rewards.

Tap on interesting locations in the room to investigate, and select and use the items you acquire. Various puzzles await, including items that need to be combined and passcodes. Organize the information you find and use your ingenuity and lateral thinking to tackle the locked-room tricks.

You can save your progress and resume from where you left off. Play at your own pace, whether you want to think deeply or explore little by little in your free time.

・Enjoy escape games with puzzles and mechanisms

・Want to enjoy item hunting and the story together

description:
Snake Game Survival Escape is a colorful snake puzzle where every move changes the board. Tap a snake to send it in the direction it faces, clear the path and find a way to free them all. The challenge is simple to understand but takes careful thinking to solve. One wrong tap can leave another snake blocked.

A BOARD FULL OF TWISTS

Each level places bright, winding snakes across a compact maze. Some have a clear route out. Others are trapped behind neighboring paths, so the order of your moves matters. Look closely at the heads, follow the direction of each body and decide which snake should leave first. This snake escape game rewards observation and smart decisions instead of random tapping.

TAP, THINK, ESCAPE

In this tap out puzzle, every snake has its own exit route. Choose one, watch it slide away and use the newly opened space to plan your next move. A crowded grid can turn into a clean board one thoughtful tap at a time. If a route looks impossible, study the turns and search for a different sequence.

WHAT MAKES EACH LEVEL FUN?

- Colorful snake paths that are easy to spot and satisfying to clear.

- Simple tap controls with decisions that become trickier as you progress.

- Compact puzzle boards that challenge your sense of direction and planning.

- A mix of quick solutions and levels that deserve a second look.

- Visually distinct snakes that make every maze feel lively.

- Short, focused challenges for a quick puzzle break.

MORE THAN A CLASSIC SNAKE GAME

This is not a traditional snake game about collecting food or growing a tail. It's a snake maze built around choosing the right order of escape. Instead of chasing points, you work through a logic puzzle, predict movement, and create an open route. Players who enjoy snake games with a thoughtful twist can test how well they read a busy board.

Every new arrangement brings a fresh question: which path needs to open before the others can move? Some snakes are almost free, while others must wait until the maze begins to unfold. Take your time, rethink your plan, and enjoy the moment the last snake slips off the board.

If you like brain games, maze puzzle games and colorful escape puzzle games, this snake puzzle offers a clear goal with plenty to think about. Solve each board through observation, patience and a few well chosen taps.

Follow the curves. Clear the crossings. Help every snake escape download and test your skills today.

• Battle Pass with seasons and rewards

🛡️ A Closely Managed Server

• Brazilian moderation team

• Direct help requests through the game, without leaving the server

• Frequent updates with new features and fixes

🚀 HOW TO PLAY

1. Install and open the app

2. Enter your nickname

3. Create a password (if you already play, use your usual one)

4. Tap Play!

💻 ALSO PLAY ON PC?

On your computer, you enter through the Windows launcher or the modpack. Guide, server IP, and downloads are at mundocobblemon.com.br. The nickname and password are the same on mobile and PC.

❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

• What is Cobblemon? An adventure with over a thousand species of creatures and turn-based battles, with attacks, abilities, and types.

• Do you need a PC to play Cobblemon on your mobile phone? No. The app runs the game directly on Android. • Do I need to download anything else? No. The app takes care of the game, mods, and updates.

• Can I play with a friend who is on a PC? Yes. Everyone joins the same server.

• Is the app paid? No. The server store is optional and not required to play.

• Did it crash or freeze? Update the app, close other open apps, and contact the team on Discord.

• Where can I see the news? On the community Discord, with the link on the website.

What was his father thinking? What feelings did he keep hidden?
