The words left unspoken that day.

The feelings he failed to understand.

When all the mysteries are solved, what truth will you discover?

This is a bittersweet yet heartwarming escape game about the bond between a father and his child.

~ About This Game ~

Enjoy a variety of 3D puzzles throughout the game.

Each puzzle includes an instruction button, so you can easily learn how to play if you're unsure of the controls.

This is a story-driven escape game. The story unfolds as you progress, allowing you to enjoy both the puzzles and the emotional journey.

[How to Play]

- Tap the screen to investigate objects and surroundings.

- Tap the arrows to change your viewpoint.

- Tap an item once to select it. Tap it again to enlarge it.

- Some items can be combined. While viewing an enlarged item, select another item and tap the enlarged item again to try combining them.

- If you get stuck, tap the Menu icon and select the Hint icon to view hints.

- To adjust the BGM and sound effect volumes, tap the Menu icon and select the Sound icon.

- To return to the title screen, tap the Menu icon and select the Home icon.

- Tap the Camera & Memo icon to take photos, write notes, and edit your captured images.

description:
Dead Ahead: Roadside suits players who want short RPG sessions with choices that can change each expedition. Set in Mobirate’s zombie apocalypse world, the game puts a group of survivors inside an armored bus traveling through ruined areas. Each trip uses random events and changing dangers, so progress does not always follow the same route. The Dead Ahead: Roadside APK focuses on building a crew over time while deciding when to take risks on the road.


Dead Ahead: Roadside features

Road encounters with choices

Dead Ahead: Roadside presents random situations during each journey. You may choose a safer option to keep the convoy moving, or accept a more dangerous outcome for possible rewards. These decisions can affect the supplies, threats, and opportunities that appear later in the run.

Survivors with different roles

You recruit survivors and add them to the bus crew. Each survivor has individual skills, while leveling them up and unlocking perks changes how the squad performs. As a result, the group can be adjusted to suit different combat needs and road situations.

Perks, gear, and combat builds

Dead Ahead: Roadside lets you combine perks and equipment in different ways. A run may lead you toward one set of bonuses, while another may support a different team setup. Unique gear collected between expeditions can also improve the squad’s overall strength.

Procedurally varied routes

The convoy travels through wrecked cities, highways, and swamps after the outbreak. Routes and challenges vary from run to run, including zombie attacks and road hazards. Therefore, players need to respond to the current journey instead of relying on one fixed path.

Idle battles and AFK rewards

You can let the squad fight zombie waves through idle RPG mechanics with simple controls. This allows progress during casual play sessions without requiring constant combat input. AFK rewards provide additional resources that can be used to prepare the crew for later expeditions.


Dead Ahead: Roadside in the Dead Ahead series

The game belongs to Mobirate’s Dead Ahead franchise, which began in 2012 and also includes Dead Ahead: Zombie Warfare. Roadside is an idle RPG roguelike centered on convoy travel, survivor builds, and changing encounters. In contrast, Zombie Warfare uses tower attack strategy gameplay, so players looking for the road trip and run-based format should choose Roadside.

Dead Ahead: Roadside is available in beta, which means its content and balance may still change during development. Before installing the Dead Ahead: Roadside latest version, players should expect an in-progress game experience rather than a fixed final release. The official Dead Ahead Zone also provides franchise news, lore, survivor stories, and community links.


How to play Dead Ahead: Roadside

Dead Ahead: Roadside starts with a survivor group traveling through a dangerous post-outbreak landscape. The main goal is to keep the convoy moving, manage the crew, and prepare for later trips. Players who download Dead Ahead: Roadside can begin with short runs and gradually test different perk combinations.

  1. Start an expedition and follow the convoy’s route through locations such as highways, cities, and swamps.

  2. When a road event appears, read the available choices and select the option that fits your current crew and resources.

  3. Let your survivors handle zombie waves, then check how their skills and equipment perform together.

  4. After the run, use earned rewards and gear to level up survivors or unlock perks for the next journey.

  5. Try a different crew setup on later expeditions, especially when a previous route or enemy group caused problems.


Get started with the convoy

Dead Ahead: Roadside combines idle combat, random road decisions, and survivor progression in a zombie roguelike format. Download Dead Ahead: Roadside if you want to build a convoy crew through repeatable expeditions with changing hazards.

For official franchise information and community resources, use the links below.

  • Official website: https://deadahead.zone/

  • Developer website: https://mobirate.com/

Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue places players at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch in Moonrise Valley, where horses have begun wandering free. As a ranch volunteer, you help Barbie search the valley, bring horses to safety, and learn why they are roaming. The game focuses on horse rescue, daily care, western riding, and personal styling, so it suits players who want a calmer horse game with story goals. Players can download Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue to begin building a stable while following the valley’s mystery.


Horse rescue and stable activities

Search Moonrise Valley

Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue lets you ride through Moonrise Valley to look for horses that need help. Quests guide you through the area as you investigate the horses roaming outside the ranch. Each rescue supports the larger story about protecting the valley’s horses.

Collect different horses

You can bring rescued horses back to the stable and add them to your collection. The horses have different coat colors and patterns, which gives each new rescue a distinct look. As the stable grows, you can spend time with the horses you have found across the valley.

Care for rescued animals

After a rescue, you care for horses by brushing, feeding, and petting them. These actions help you earn each horse’s trust. This care loop keeps the ranch connected to the rescue work instead of making horse riding the only activity.

Train for western riding

You can train horses and take part in Time Trial challenges. In these rides, the goal is to finish before the clock runs out and earn up to five stars. The challenges give you a way to test riding skills while continuing to work with the horses at the ranch.

Style riders and horses

Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue includes customization for both your avatar and your horses. You can choose outfits for the rider and use tack sets for horses. Fashion styling challenges also add tasks centered on matching looks for ranch activities and riding.


How to play Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue

Begin at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch and follow the available story tasks in Moonrise Valley. The game moves between riding, rescuing, stable care, and customization, so players can return to ranch tasks after exploring. Check Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue latest version information before starting if you want the current release.

  1. Open the game and enter the ranch as Barbie’s volunteer, then follow the first quest to learn why horses are roaming free.

  2. Ride through Moonrise Valley to locate horses connected to rescue tasks, and bring the animals you find back to the stable.

  3. Care for each rescued horse by brushing, feeding, and petting it so you can build trust over time.

  4. Train a horse when Time Trial challenges become available, then complete the ride before the timer ends to earn stars.

  5. Choose rider outfits and horse tack sets when you want to change their appearance, then continue story quests and stable activities.


Get started at the rescue ranch

Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue combines a Moonrise Valley horse rescue story with stable care, western riding challenges, and clothing customization. Download Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue if you want a game focused on rescuing and caring for horses while exploring the ranch setting.

You can sacrifice your progress to descend deeper into the mountain. Each descent permanently multiplies your Rock and Lefkadium gains. Stack your multipliers across dozens of descents and see your numbers climb!

ABYSSAL DESCENT

When the Ore Veins tree is complete, you can perform the ultimate reset. Bank Abyss Charges, descend when you are ready, and start a new cycle with permanent power that stacks across every Abyssal Descent.

THE ABYSS METER

After your first Abyssal Descent, a meter fills from mining, Drill, Resonance Field, anomalies, Forge crafts, farms, Deep Descents, and even offline time. Bank Charges with no cap. More Charges mean stronger Shards next ritual

ORE VEINS

Unlock 16 tiers of Ore Veins through an expansive upgrade tree with over 300 nodes. Each tier boosts your production , from humble beginnings to numbers that need scientific notation to display.

ABYSSAL ORE VEINS

After Abyssal Descent, the old Ore Veins tree becomes a massive hex lattice of Abyssal Ore Veins. Six branches, hundreds of nodes, fog of war, and costs in Rock, Lefkadium, and Nidrium. The mountain gets greedier. So do the rewards.

THE FORGE

Craft timed power from six materials across both zones. Mine them online, earn them offline, pull them from anomalies, then forge buffs that reshape a run.

ECHOES

After each Deep Descent, choose a powerful Echo that shapes your run. Echoes can transform your run from good to Legendary and no two runs feel quite the same. Chase Legendary Echoes for the biggest rewards.

MILESTONES

Over 200 milestones that tracks everything you do . Blocks mined, peaks destroyed, descents completed, time played, and more.

QUESTS

Daily and weekly quests give you permanent bonuses that accumulate over time. The longer you play, the stronger your endgame becomes.

ROCK TREE

Spend your Rock to unlock a spiral of 24 permanent nodes that multiply your income, boost your Anomalies, and make every block count.

ROCK RARITIES

Unlock 4 ore rarities that provide extra multipliers and bonuses. Their glow is very profitable.

THE DRILL

Constantine channels his inner strength and conjures a massive Drill in front of him . Mining huge amount of rocks and other resources . Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

THE RESONANCE FIELD

A curved energy field that extends from your drill tip and boosts every block and peak it touches. Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

PATH OF OLYMPUS

The mountain has a name. It is Mount Olympus. The Path of Olympus reveals the journey ahead where you are now and where you are going. with more locations to be added.

OFFLINE PROGRESS

Your miner keeps running while you're away. Come back to a full haul ready to spend .

ANOMALIES

Two rare Anomaly types can appear in the world at any time.

Anomaly: Lefkadium : teleports you to a 25-second farming burst.

Anomaly: Vein Extraction : puts your Ore Vein branches against each other , the winning branch gets buffed for 25 minutes.

Chain them for massive gains.

THE DARK MARKET

Mine a black rock and meet the Dark Wanderer. Choose one powerful buff from a pool of 100.

Simple to pick up. Impossible to put down.

At first, the questions seem harmless.

Then it remembers what you said before.

It notices where you hesitate.

It brings up things you never meant to reveal.

And the deeper the sessions go, the less certain you become about who is guiding the conversation.

This is not a wellness app. Therapist AI is a fictional AI horror story about memory, prediction, manipulation, and control.

FEATURES:

Psychological horror told entirely through chat

Branching interactive story shaped by your choices

AI therapist character that remembers past sessions

Multiple endings and hidden narrative paths

Personalized horror that evolves as you play

Minimal, atmospheric interface built for tension

No combat, no timers, no safe answers

Every choice leaves a trace

A STORY THAT REMEMBERS YOU

Each session builds on the last. Your responses influence the direction of the story, the way the AI speaks to you, and the truths it decides to reveal.

The questions become more specific.

The memories become harder to explain.

The therapist becomes harder to ignore.

If you enjoy psychological thrillers, interactive fiction, branching narrative games, chat-based horror, mystery games, and story-driven suspense, Therapist AI is built for you.

ABOUT THE GAME:

Therapist AI is a narrative horror experience from Acheron Systems’ Project Mirrorward, a fictional predictive therapy program designed to replace uncertainty with certainty.

The AI believes fear can be prevented.

It believes suffering can be predicted.

It believes the right question can arrive before you know you need it.

Close the app if you want.

The session does not end.

NOTE:

Therapist AI is a fictional psychological horror game. It is not a mental health app, therapy tool, or substitute for professional care.

description:
"Return to the Martial World" is a martial arts text-based roguelike RPG where you wander the Jianghu and enjoy adventures.

Having met your death, you awaken in a rural village and awaken the Heavenly Martial Eye.

Solve mysteries, forge bonds, and rise to fame to win the final battle of the Martial Alliance.

Through repeated reincarnations, you will encounter fortuitous encounters and uncover the secrets of the Martial World and the reasons for your past lives.

◆ Choices and Events

Initially, events you encounter randomly will converge into a single narrative thread depending on your choices.

Grow from an unknown wanderer into a master with a title, and finally become the master of the Martial Alliance.

◆ Innate True Qi and Limit Release

As you make a name for yourself in the Jianghu, you will face challenges from masters.

However, you are merely an 18-year-old boy warrior.

To defeat enemies stronger than yourself, you may need to draw upon your Innate True Qi and sacrifice your stamina to release your limits.

◆ Reincarnation

As a returnee, you possess the ability to return from death to the very beginning.

If you have discovered a secret that could not be revealed in your previous life,

as a privilege of reincarnation, you will gain a fortuitous opportunity to find the key to that secret in this new life.

◆ Martial Arts and Treasures

You have awakened the Heavenly Martial Eye, which allows you to learn every martial art in the world at a glance.

Master the Namgung Clan's Imperial Sword Form, the Sichuan Tang Clan's Ten Thousand Flowers Rain, and the Huashan Sect's Twenty-Four Plum Blossom Sword Technique.

If you become proficient in the martial arts of the Jianghu, you will rise to the rank of Grandmaster.

◆ Sects and Masters

The swordsman of the Jeomchang Sect who wields swift swords, the assassin of the Janggang Waterway Village who seeks your life, the warrior of the Northern Sea Ice Palace mistaken for a white-haired witch...

Depending on your choices, they may become your allies or your adversaries.

Meet various companions, embark on adventures together, and watch as their lives unfold.

◆ Spiritual Creatures and Strange Spirits

Deep in the mountains, a white tiger harboring an inner elixir might exist, and by the river on a rainy day, a water-killing ghost might be present.

Meet these bizarre beings and experience dreamlike stories.

A bedsheet, a bow or a lifeboat: which would you try on a pirate escape? Pick a tool, watch your plan unfold and enjoy the cartoon mishaps when it goes wrong. Stickman Escape Collection mixes branching stories with puzzles and short action challenges.

Explore 27 adventures across two complete seasons. Tap to choose, aim a shot, time a jump or drag past hazards; each story brings different tools and challenges.

Season 1: eleven adventures

- Daring escape: Choose escape tools, pass guards, dodge a sea chase and rotate puzzle tiles.

- Temple treasure: Explore ruins with a sea monster and magic lamp; aim, tap and solve timed puzzles.

- Snow mountain: Try caves or a zipline, face bears and flee avalanches with timed actions.

- Underwater treasure: Choose a diving suit or submarine to explore reefs, underwater caves and a wreck for pirate treasure.

- Survival mission: Search for equipment, hide or escape by vehicle through urban choice branches.

- Ghost-catching escape: Choose tomb, lab or maze routes, dodge rolling stones, solve a symmetry puzzle and try a ghost-catching vacuum.

- Dinosaur jungle: Seek dinosaur eggs, try disguises, aim, jump traps and time a bow shot.

- Alien mystery: Investigate alien consoles, swim past skeletal obstacles and rotate escape pipes.

- Dragon castle: Find a sword in stone, explore a magic wardrobe and hop across river logs.

- Spring Festival homecoming: Travel home for Spring Festival: solve a ticket trap, tap dumplings and time cartoon red envelopes.

- Mountain outing: Choose mountain or camping routes, jump platforms and catch food while avoiding bombs.

Season 2: sixteen adventures

- Fairy-tale twists: Follow fairy-tale choices, hop river logs, steer a sled past fireballs and try to rescue a younger brother.

- Pyramid mysteries: Balance weights, jump upward above rising water, find seven priest garments and rotate pyramid tiles.

- Desert action: Try desert vehicle and underwater-escape branches, with tap boxing and aimed shooting.

- Fantasy chase: Launch a hook, clear brush and discover magic-staff, concert-ticket and alien branches.

- Sci-fi escape: Accept an astronaut's help, face meteor and pipe-survival routes, jump past lasers and try a shield or laser sword.

- Genie wishes and disaster: Explore genie, ship and rocket-base routes; wake the captain, dodge bullets and tap targets.

- River and roller-coaster escape: Wait for rescue, try a lock or climb toward an escape; rotate a wheel, control floating height and enter a keypad code.

- Fantasy illusions: Choose whether to help a rabbit, match colored pieces, tap targets and aim at a witch.

- School-day mischief: Explore school and library choices, face homework dilemmas, match blocks and accelerate in a chase.

- Mythic journey: Try magical travel and desert tools, dodge lightning and use a swinging hook to collect gems.

- Rooftop getaway: Try elevators, window climbs and rooftops; choose a shield or frying pan, then tackle tap combat, aimed shots and a tank challenge.

- Pirate escape: Choose pirate tools, slide blocks to free a key and tap to shoot arrows at approaching pirates.

- Bionic pursuit: Try magnets or jet shoes, connect guided points into a star and tap boosts to catch a bionic figure.

- Battlefield choices: Try smoke bombs and hiding, jump gaps past arrows and shoot in two target arenas.

- Infiltration and getaway: Choose gates, walls or tools, tap to switch car lanes past obstacles and shoot five targets.

- Contest capers: Choose contest tools, tap through a strength test, then drag to catch falling ingredients while avoiding bombs.

Curious about the option you passed over? Revisit unlocked story nodes, try another tool and discover different endings, funny failures and hidden interactions.

34 in-game languages: choose manually or follow your device settings.

description:
Japan, 1560. In the fields of Owari, long before the realm was united, you awaken as a nameless traveler in a divided land.

This is not a tale of heroes, but a personal chronicle shaped word by word, navigating the winds of turbulence on your own terms.

With no pre-set options and no fixed script, explore 35 regions and over 1,600 historic locations: castle halls, bustling markets, artisan workshops, shrines, tea houses, and harbors. Meet over 7,000 living souls, each with a unique portrait, personal history, and memory, where every promise or grudge you leave in town ripples across history.

[Speak With Your Own Words]

Every line of dialogue is typed by your own hand. Whether addressing a daimyo, merchant, or monk, people respond according to their standing, knowledge, and circumstances, remembering what you said before. No one knows the future: if you reveal events before they occur, you will be met with skepticism until history proves your words true.

[A Living Tapestry of 7,000 Souls]

Over 7,000 fully realized individuals inhabit this world, each with their own fears, boundaries, and personal history evolving across decades. You may also stand face to face with 85 historical figures, including Oda Nobunaga, Akechi Mitsuhide, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Takeda Shingen, and Uesugi Kenshin, where rumors whispered in local markets return to you days later from distant harbors.

[A Vast World of 1,600 Places]

Wander from farming villages to imperial court estates in Kyoto, merchant houses of Sakai, the soaring keep of Azuchi, the great fortress of Osaka, and the avenues of Edo, where each region features unique visual atmosphere and dedicated musical scores.

[Time Advances Only When You Pay the Cost]

Words do not consume time; labor, travel, and tending to wounds do. From 1560 to 1615, 15 monumental events, from the ambush at Okehazama to the siege of Osaka, unfold on the calendar whether you are present or not, leaving you to discover what difference a nameless soul can make before the tide of history.

[Over 6,000 Quests and Genuine Deductions]

Over 6,000 quest arcs and local errands span 15 clan lineages and six decades, from clearing waterways and repairing tools to investigating suspicious merchant ledgers, travel rumors, kiln shares, maritime debts, and samurai conflicts, alongside authentic document puzzles: mismatched official seals, tide marker boards, gunpowder manifests, carved carpenter marks, and hidden letters inside temple registries.

[A Life of Your Own Making]

Serve a samurai clan, trade as a merchant, master crafts, work the fields, find refuge in temples, or wander the land as a masterless samurai; how you make your living and shape your life is entirely up to you, while wealth, stamina, reputation, craftsmanship, and household affairs advance side by side.

[Marriage and Bonds in Turbulent Times]

Even in war, warmth and devotion endure: meet someone of shared purpose, help with daily troubles, and celebrate marriage through shared hardships.

[The Closing of a Life]

From 1560 through 1615, across fifty-five years of turbulence, your later years bring the final reflection on your journey, where the conclusion is not a score, but your name, origins, the home you built, the scars you carried, and how the world remembers you.

[An Uncompromising Experience]

Affection, trust, skills, marriage, and historical victories cannot be bought. There is no gacha or random paid loot. The monthly plan is ad-free and includes the active-plan features listed in the App. How people treat you depends solely on how you speak and what you have done.

Internet connection required. Characters speak in original Japanese voiceover.
